# Guardian Roofing, Gutters & Insulation

> > Guardian Roofing provides residential roofing, gutter installation, and attic insulation services across Washington and Oregon with a commitment to customer satisfaction and community involvement.

Guardian Roofing operates from two main locations in Auburn, WA and Wilsonville, OR, serving the greater Seattle and Portland metropolitan areas. The company features the Guardian HALO Project for charitable programs and offers products from CertainTeed, GAF, and K-Guard.

## Key Topics

- Roofing services
- Gutter installation
- Attic insulation
- Pacific Northwest service areas
- Roof replacement
- K-Guard gutters
- CertainTeed products
- GAF roofing materials
- Guardian HALO Project
- Customer satisfaction guarantee
- Washington and Oregon coverage
- Free roof inspections
- Community involvement
- Charitable programs
